source_text:
MUTUAL NON-DISCLOSURE AGREEMENT

This Mutual Non-Disclosure Agreement ("Agreement") is entered into as of January 15, 2025 ("Effective Date") by and between Acme Corporation, a Delaware corporation ("Acme"), and Beta Industries LLC, a New York limited liability company ("Beta").

1. CONFIDENTIAL INFORMATION. Each Party agrees to hold in confidence all Confidential Information disclosed by the other Party.

2. TERM. This Agreement shall remain in effect for three (3) years from the Effective Date.

3. GOVERNING LAW. This Agreement shall be governed by the laws of the State of Delaware.

4. TERMINATION. Either Party may terminate this Agreement upon thirty (30) days written notice to the other Party.

5. ENTIRE AGREEMENT. This Agreement constitutes the entire agreement between the Parties.
notes: Straightforward mutual NDA. No significant risks expected.

source_text:
EMPLOYMENT AGREEMENT

Entered into June 1, 2025 between Theta Healthcare Systems ("Employer") and Dr. Maria Santos ("Employee").

1. POSITION. Employee shall serve as Senior Physician.

2. COMPENSATION. Annual base salary of $250,000. Annual performance bonus up to 20% of base salary.

3. BENEFITS. Health insurance, retirement savings plan, and twenty-five (25) days paid time off per year.

4. CONFIDENTIALITY. Employee agrees to maintain confidentiality of all patient information and proprietary business information.

5. TERMINATION. Either Party may terminate at any time with or without cause upon thirty (30) days written notice.
notes: Standard employment. At-will termination is a watch item.

source_text:
SOFTWARE AS A SERVICE AGREEMENT

February 1, 2025 between CloudScale Platform Inc. ("Provider") and Retail Dynamics Corporation ("Customer").

1. SERVICES. Non-exclusive, non-transferable right to access the CloudScale platform.

2. FEES. Monthly subscription fee of $5,000. Provider may suspend access if payment is not received within ten (10) days of the due date.

3. DATA SECURITY. Provider shall implement appropriate technical and organizational measures to protect Customer data.

4. SERVICE LEVELS. Provider guarantees 99.5% uptime monthly.

5. LIMITATION OF LIABILITY. IN NO EVENT SHALL PROVIDER'S TOTAL LIABILITY EXCEED THE FEES PAID BY CUSTOMER IN THE TWELVE (12) MONTHS PRECEDING THE CLAIM.

6. INTELLECTUAL PROPERTY. Provider retains all rights, title, and interest in and to the Service.

7. TERM. Initial term of twelve (12) months. Thereafter, automatically renews for successive twelve-month periods unless either Party provides written notice of non-renewal at least sixty (60) days prior to the end of the then-current term.
expected_evidence_quotes: FEES PAID BY CUSTOMER IN THE TWELVE (12) MONTHS
notes: Standard SaaS. Liability cap and auto-renewal are key risks.

source_text:
NON-DISCLOSURE AND NON-SOLICITATION AGREEMENT

March 1, 2025 between Gamma Technologies Inc. ("Company") and Delta Consulting Group ("Contractor").

1. CONFIDENTIAL INFORMATION includes trade secrets, proprietary technology, customer lists, and financial information.

2. OBLIGATIONS. Contractor shall: (a) maintain confidence; (b) use solely for engagement; (c) not disclose without written consent.

3. NON-SOLICITATION. During the term and for twelve (12) months thereafter, Contractor shall not directly or indirectly solicit any employee of Company.

4. TERM. Twenty-four (24) months from date of signing.

5. REMEDIES. Any breach may cause irreparable harm entitling Company to seek injunctive relief in addition to monetary damages.
notes: 12-month non-solicitation is aggressive. 24-month confidentiality term.

source_text:
MASTER SERVICES AGREEMENT

April 1, 2025 between Omega Software Solutions Ltd. ("Provider") and Sigma Enterprises plc ("Client").

1. SERVICES. Provider shall provide software development and consulting services per mutually agreed Statements of Work.

2. PAYMENT TERMS. Client shall pay within thirty (30) days of invoice. Late payments accrue interest at 1.5% per month.

3. INTELLECTUAL PROPERTY. All IP developed for Client under an SOW shall be owned by Client upon full payment. Pre-existing Provider IP remains owned by Provider.

4. CONFIDENTIALITY. Each Party shall maintain confidentiality of the other Party's Confidential Information.

5. TERM AND TERMINATION. Initial term of twelve (12) months, automatically renewing for successive twelve-month periods unless terminated by either Party with sixty (60) days written notice.

6. GOVERNING LAW. Laws of England and Wales.
notes: Standard MSA. Auto-renewal and 1.5%/month late interest are watch items.

source_text:
CONFIDENTIALITY AND NON-COMPETE AGREEMENT

May 1, 2025 between Zeta Manufacturing Co. ("Employer") and James Chen ("Employee").

1. CONFIDENTIALITY OBLIGATIONS. Employee shall hold in strict confidence all Confidential Information and shall not use or disclose any Confidential Information without Employer's prior written consent.

2. NON-COMPETITION. During employment and for twenty-four (24) months following termination for any reason, Employee shall not directly or indirectly engage in any business that competes with Employer within the Territory.

3. TERRITORY. "Territory" means any state or country where Employer conducts business or has actual plans to conduct business.

4. NON-SOLICITATION. During employment and for thirty-six (36) months thereafter, Employee shall not solicit any employee, consultant, or independent contractor of Employer.

5. GOVERNING LAW. Laws of California. Disputes resolved in state or federal courts in San Francisco County.
notes: 24-month non-compete + 36-month non-solicitation + world-wide territory. Should trigger HIGH risks.

source_text:
CONSULTING AGREEMENT

January 10, 2025 between Apex Strategy Group LLC ("Consultant") and Meridian Retail Inc. ("Client").

1. SERVICES. Consultant shall provide strategic advisory services as described in Schedule A.

2. COMPENSATION. Client shall pay Consultant $15,000 per month, invoiced on the first of each month, due within fifteen (15) days.

3. INTELLECTUAL PROPERTY. All deliverables, reports, and work product created by Consultant under this Agreement shall be owned by Client as works made for hire.

4. INDEMNIFICATION. Consultant shall indemnify, defend, and hold harmless Client from any claims arising out of Consultant's gross negligence or willful misconduct.

5. CONFIDENTIALITY. Consultant shall not disclose Client's Confidential Information during and for two (2) years after the term.

6. TERM. Six (6) months from the Effective Date. Either party may terminate upon fourteen (14) days written notice.
notes: 14-day termination notice is short. Indemnity is one-sided (Consultant only).

source_text:
ENTERPRISE SOFTWARE LICENSE AND SERVICES AGREEMENT

March 15, 2025 between NovaTech Systems Inc. ("Vendor") and GlobalBank Corporation ("Customer").

1. LICENSE GRANT. Vendor grants Customer a non-exclusive, non-transferable license to use the Software solely for internal business purposes.

2. FEES AND PAYMENT. Annual license fee of $500,000 due within thirty (30) days of invoice. Vendor may suspend the license immediately upon payment default without additional notice.

3. LIABILITY. VENDOR'S TOTAL LIABILITY SHALL NOT EXCEED THE GREATER OF (A) $10,000 OR (B) THE FEES PAID IN THE PRIOR THREE (3) MONTHS.

4. INDEMNIFICATION. Customer shall indemnify and hold harmless Vendor from any third-party claims arising from Customer's use of the Software. Vendor shall indemnify Customer only against claims that the Software infringes a third-party patent or copyright.

5. DATA PROCESSING. Vendor may process Customer data to improve its services and may share aggregated, anonymized data with third parties.

6. AMENDMENT. Vendor reserves the right to modify any terms of this Agreement upon thirty (30) days written notice to Customer. Continued use of the Software constitutes acceptance.

7. TERM. Three (3) years. Automatically renews for successive one-year terms unless Customer provides ninety (90) days written notice of non-renewal.
expected_evidence_quotes: Vendor reserves the right to modify
notes: Multiple critical issues: $10K cap on $500K/yr contract, unilateral modification, data sharing. Most complex case.

source_text:
COMMERCIAL LEASE AGREEMENT

February 15, 2025 between Harbor Properties LLC ("Landlord") and Fresh Grounds Coffee Co. ("Tenant").

1. PREMISES. Landlord leases to Tenant the commercial space at 450 Market Street, Suite 200, San Francisco, CA.

2. TERM. Lease commences March 1, 2025 and expires February 28, 2027.

3. RENT. Monthly base rent of $8,500, due on the first of each month. Late payments subject to a 5% late fee after a five (5) day grace period.

4. SECURITY DEPOSIT. Tenant shall deposit $17,000 (two months rent) upon signing.

5. USE. Premises shall be used solely for the operation of a coffee shop and related retail activities.

6. GOVERNING LAW. Laws of the State of California.
notes: Simple commercial lease. Low risk overall.

source_text:
MASTER SERVICES AGREEMENT

July 1, 2025 between Pinnacle Data Solutions Inc. ("Vendor") and Cascade Financial Group ("Client").

1. SERVICES. Vendor shall provide data analytics and AI model development services per individual Statements of Work.

2. PAYMENT. Client shall pay invoices within forty-five (45) days. Disputed amounts must be raised in writing within ten (10) days of receipt or are deemed accepted.

3. INTELLECTUAL PROPERTY. All inventions, discoveries, or improvements made by Vendor personnel during performance of Services shall be assigned to Vendor. Client receives only a limited non-exclusive license to use deliverables.

4. LIABILITY. Neither party shall be liable for indirect, incidental, or consequential damages. Vendor's aggregate liability shall not exceed fifty thousand dollars ($50,000).

5. INDEMNIFICATION. Each party shall indemnify the other for breach of this Agreement. Additionally, Client shall indemnify Vendor against any claims arising from Client's use of the deliverables.

6. DATA PRIVACY. Vendor may retain and use anonymized versions of Client data for model training and improvement of Vendor's products.

7. GOVERNING LAW. State of New York. EACH PARTY WAIVES ITS RIGHT TO A JURY TRIAL.

8. TERM. Two (2) years. Automatically renews for one (1) year terms unless sixty (60) days advance written notice of non-renewal is provided.
expected_evidence_quotes: WAIVES ITS RIGHT TO A JURY TRIAL
notes: Complex MSA: vendor retains IP, $50K cap, jury waiver, data retention for training. Multiple high risks.

source_text:
EMPLOYMENT AGREEMENT

September 1, 2025 between Vertex Tech Corp. ("Company") and Sarah Kim ("Executive").

1. POSITION. Executive Vice President of Engineering.

2. BASE SALARY. $320,000 per year. Executive is eligible for an annual bonus of up to 40% of base salary based on Company and individual performance.

3. EQUITY. Executive shall receive stock options for 50,000 shares, vesting over four (4) years with a one-year cliff.

4. NON-COMPETE. During employment and for twelve (12) months following termination, Executive shall not engage in any competing business within North America.

5. CONFIDENTIALITY. Executive shall maintain the confidentiality of all Company proprietary information during and for five (5) years after employment.

6. TERMINATION. Company may terminate Executive without cause upon ninety (90) days written notice. Executive may resign upon thirty (30) days written notice.

7. SEVERANCE. If terminated without cause, Executive shall receive six (6) months base salary as severance.
notes: Executive employment: 12-month non-compete in North America is broad. Asymmetric notice periods (90 vs 30 days).

source_text:
PROFESSIONAL SERVICES AGREEMENT

October 1, 2025 between Quantum Analytics LLC ("Firm") and MedCore Diagnostics Inc. ("Client").

1. SCOPE OF SERVICES. Firm shall develop a custom machine learning diagnostic model as specified in Exhibit A.

2. FEES. Fixed fee of $750,000. Fifty percent ($375,000) due upon signing; remaining fifty percent due upon delivery. No refunds under any circumstances.

3. INTELLECTUAL PROPERTY. Firm retains all ownership of the model architecture, algorithms, and training methodology. Client receives a perpetual, non-exclusive license for internal use only. Client may not modify, sublicense, or create derivative works.

4. WARRANTIES. Firm makes no warranties, express or implied, including any warranty of fitness for a particular purpose or merchantability. THE MODEL IS PROVIDED AS-IS.

5. LIABILITY. FIRM'S TOTAL LIABILITY SHALL NOT EXCEED $10,000, REGARDLESS OF THE CAUSE OF ACTION.

6. INDEMNIFICATION. Client shall indemnify Firm from any and all claims, losses, or damages arising from Client's use of the model, including claims related to medical diagnosis errors.

7. DISPUTE RESOLUTION. All disputes shall be resolved by binding arbitration in New York under AAA rules. Each party waives the right to bring class actions.

8. TERM. Commences on signing. No termination for convenience permitted after the first payment.
notes: Highest-risk case: $10K cap on $750K contract, no refund, no termination right, client indemnifies for medical errors. Critical risk expected.

source_text:
OFFICE LEASE AGREEMENT

November 1, 2025 between Skyline Tower REIT ("Landlord") and BluePeak Ventures LLC ("Tenant").

1. PREMISES. Approximately 4,200 square feet on the 18th floor of Skyline Tower, Chicago, IL.

2. TERM. Five (5) years commencing December 1, 2025.

3. BASE RENT. $18,000 per month for years 1-2; $19,500 per month for years 3-5. Tenant shall also pay its proportionate share of building operating expenses.

4. PERSONAL GUARANTEE. Tenant's obligations are personally guaranteed by John Park, sole member of Tenant LLC.

5. ASSIGNMENT. Tenant may not assign this lease or sublease the premises without Landlord's prior written consent, not to be unreasonably withheld.

6. DEFAULT. In the event of default, Landlord may terminate the lease upon five (5) days written notice and recover all remaining rent owed for the full lease term.

7. GOVERNING LAW. State of Illinois.
notes: Personal guarantee + 5-day default notice + accelerated full-term rent creates meaningful risk.

source_text:
ONE-WAY NON-DISCLOSURE AGREEMENT

December 1, 2025 between Ironclad Ventures LLC ("Disclosing Party") and Marco Rossi ("Receiving Party").

1. PURPOSE. The parties are exploring a potential investment opportunity.

2. CONFIDENTIAL INFORMATION. Receiving Party shall keep confidential all non-public information disclosed by Disclosing Party relating to the potential transaction.

3. PERMITTED DISCLOSURES. Receiving Party may disclose Confidential Information to its legal and financial advisors on a need-to-know basis.

4. TERM. This Agreement is effective for eighteen (18) months from the date hereof.

5. GOVERNING LAW. Laws of the State of New York.
notes: One-way NDA for deal exploration. No termination clause is a minor gap.

source_text:
SOFTWARE SUBSCRIPTION AGREEMENT

January 5, 2025 between TaskFlow Inc. ("Provider") and Bright Media Group ("Customer").

1. SERVICE. Provider grants Customer access to the TaskFlow project management platform on a monthly subscription basis.

2. FEES. $299 per month per seat (up to 10 seats). Billed monthly in advance. Customer may cancel at any time with thirty (30) days notice.

3. DATA. Provider shall not sell Customer data to third parties. Customer data shall be deleted within ninety (90) days of account closure.

4. UPTIME. Provider targets 99% uptime but makes no guarantee. No service credits are provided for downtime.

5. LIMITATION OF LIABILITY. Provider's liability is limited to the fees paid in the most recent calendar month.

6. GOVERNING LAW. State of Delaware.
expected_evidence_quotes: fees paid in the most recent calendar month
notes: Simple SaaS. Liability capped at one month fees. No SLA guarantee.

source_text:
MANAGED SERVICES AGREEMENT

April 15, 2025 between ClearOps IT Services ("Provider") and Nautilus Shipping Ltd. ("Client").

1. SERVICES. Provider shall manage Client's IT infrastructure including servers, network, and security monitoring per Schedule A.

2. FEES. Monthly fee of $22,000. Fee may be increased by Provider upon sixty (60) days written notice, up to 5% annually.

3. SERVICE LEVELS. Provider guarantees 99.9% network availability. For each hour of downtime beyond the monthly SLA, Client receives a credit of $200, up to a maximum of one month's fees.

4. LIABILITY. Provider's aggregate liability shall not exceed six (6) months of fees paid under this Agreement.

5. CONFIDENTIALITY. Each party shall keep the other's Confidential Information in confidence for the duration of the Agreement and for three (3) years thereafter.

6. TERM. One (1) year, automatically renewing for successive one-year terms unless either party provides ninety (90) days written notice.

7. GOVERNING LAW. England and Wales.
expected_evidence_quotes: increased by Provider upon sixty (60) days
notes: Managed IT services. Unilateral price increase clause and SLA credit cap are risks.

source_text:
CHIEF FINANCIAL OFFICER EMPLOYMENT AGREEMENT

May 15, 2025 between CrestLine Holdings Inc. ("Company") and David Okafor ("Executive").

1. ROLE. Executive shall serve as Chief Financial Officer reporting to the CEO.

2. COMPENSATION. Base salary of $450,000. Annual bonus up to 60% of base salary. Participation in the Long-Term Incentive Plan.

3. NON-COMPETE. For twenty-four (24) months after termination for any reason, Executive shall not work for, advise, or hold an ownership interest greater than 2% in any direct competitor operating in the financial services industry worldwide.

4. NON-SOLICITATION OF CUSTOMERS. For thirty (30) months after termination, Executive shall not solicit any customer of Company with whom Executive had material contact during the last two years of employment.

5. NON-SOLICITATION OF EMPLOYEES. For twenty-four (24) months after termination, Executive shall not recruit or hire any Company employee.

6. CLAWBACK. Any bonus paid in the preceding three (3) years is subject to clawback if the Company restates its financial results or if Executive is terminated for cause.

7. ARBITRATION. All disputes shall be resolved by confidential binding arbitration. Executive waives any right to participate in class or collective proceedings.
notes: CFO employment with worldwide non-compete, 30-month customer non-solicitation, and bonus clawback. Aggressive.

source_text:
SOFTWARE LICENSE AGREEMENT

June 1, 2025 between Helios Software Corp. ("Licensor") and Pacific Retail Partners Inc. ("Licensee").

1. GRANT. Licensor grants Licensee a non-exclusive, non-transferable license to install and use the RetailOS platform at up to five (5) store locations.

2. LICENSE FEE. One-time fee of $120,000 due within fifteen (15) days of signing. Annual maintenance fee of $18,000 thereafter.

3. RESTRICTIONS. Licensee shall not: (a) copy or duplicate the software; (b) reverse engineer or decompile; (c) sublicense or transfer rights without written consent.

4. WARRANTIES. Licensor warrants the software will perform materially as described in the documentation for ninety (90) days. THEREAFTER ALL WARRANTIES ARE DISCLAIMED.

5. LIABILITY. LICENSOR'S AGGREGATE LIABILITY SHALL NOT EXCEED THE LICENSE FEE PAID IN THE PRIOR TWELVE (12) MONTHS.

6. INDEMNIFICATION. Each party shall indemnify the other for claims arising from its own breach or gross negligence.

7. TERM. Perpetual unless terminated. Licensor may terminate immediately upon Licensee's material breach.
notes: Perpetual software license. Immediate termination right for licensor and 90-day warranty window are watch items.

source_text:
FREELANCE CONSULTING AGREEMENT

August 1, 2025 between Maria Torres ("Consultant") and Bright Ideas Digital Ltd. ("Client").

1. SERVICES. Consultant shall provide UX design and research services on a project basis.

2. RATE. $150 per hour. Invoiced bi-weekly. Client shall pay within twenty-one (21) days of invoice.

3. INTELLECTUAL PROPERTY. All creative works and deliverables produced by Consultant under this Agreement are works made for hire and shall be owned by Client.

4. CONFIDENTIALITY. Consultant shall not disclose Client's business information or project details during or after the engagement.

5. INDEPENDENT CONTRACTOR. Consultant is an independent contractor and not an employee of Client.

6. TERMINATION. Either party may terminate upon seven (7) days written notice. Client shall pay for all work completed through the termination date.
notes: Simple freelance agreement. 7-day notice is short but typical for freelancers. Missing governing law.

source_text:
SUPPLY AND PURCHASE AGREEMENT

September 15, 2025 between NorthStar Components Inc. ("Supplier") and Velocity Manufacturing Corp. ("Buyer").

1. PRODUCTS. Supplier shall supply precision-engineered components as specified in Purchase Orders issued by Buyer.

2. PRICING. Unit prices as set forth in Schedule A. Supplier may increase prices with ninety (90) days written notice. Buyer may reject price increase and terminate within thirty (30) days.

3. DELIVERY. Supplier shall deliver within fourteen (14) days of Purchase Order. Late delivery penalty: 0.5% of order value per day, up to a maximum of 5%.

4. WARRANTY. Supplier warrants components are free from defects for twelve (12) months from delivery. Defective components shall be replaced at no charge.

5. LIABILITY. Neither party shall be liable for consequential or indirect damages. Supplier's aggregate liability capped at the value of the Purchase Order giving rise to the claim.

6. FORCE MAJEURE. Neither party is liable for delays caused by events beyond reasonable control including natural disasters, labor disputes, or government actions.

7. GOVERNING LAW. State of Michigan.
notes: Standard supply agreement. Delivery penalty capped at 5% and unilateral price increase right are moderate concerns.

source_text:
MUTUAL CONFIDENTIALITY AND STANDSTILL AGREEMENT

October 1, 2025 between Redwood Capital Management LP ("Redwood") and Crestfield Technologies Inc. ("Crestfield").

1. CONFIDENTIAL INFORMATION. Each party agrees to protect the other's non-public financial, strategic, and technical information disclosed in connection with a potential acquisition.

2. STANDSTILL. For twenty-four (24) months from the date hereof, Redwood shall not, directly or indirectly, acquire or seek to acquire more than 5% of Crestfield's outstanding shares, or make any public announcements regarding a transaction without Crestfield's consent.

3. NON-SOLICITATION. For twenty-four (24) months, neither party shall solicit or hire any employee of the other party who was involved in the transaction discussions.

4. RESIDUAL INFORMATION. The receiving party shall not be liable for use of Confidential Information retained in the unaided memories of its representatives.

5. REMEDIES. Monetary damages may be inadequate; either party may seek specific performance or injunctive relief without posting a bond.

6. GOVERNING LAW. State of Delaware. Exclusive jurisdiction in the Court of Chancery of the State of Delaware.
notes: M&A NDA with standstill provision and residual information carve-out. Nuanced risks for acquirer.

source_text:
COMMERCIAL LEASE AGREEMENT

November 15, 2025 between Pacific Gateway Properties LLC ("Landlord") and Momentum Fitness Inc. ("Tenant").

1. PREMISES. Approximately 8,500 sq ft at 1200 Industrial Blvd, Oakland, CA for operation of a fitness facility.

2. TERM. Ten (10) years commencing January 1, 2026. No early termination right for Tenant.

3. RENT. Base rent $28,000/month, increasing 4% annually. Tenant also pays 100% of property taxes, building insurance, and all maintenance costs (triple net).

4. PERSONAL GUARANTEE. All obligations are personally guaranteed by Rachel Foster, CEO of Tenant, jointly and severally.

5. ASSIGNMENT. Tenant may not assign or sublease without Landlord consent, which may be withheld in Landlord's sole discretion.

6. DEFAULT. Landlord may terminate upon three (3) days written notice after default. Tenant liable for all remaining rent plus Landlord's re-letting costs.

7. DEMOLITION. Landlord may terminate this lease upon one hundred eighty (180) days notice if Landlord decides to demolish or substantially renovate the building.

8. GOVERNING LAW. California.
expected_evidence_quotes: No early termination right for Tenant
notes: 10-year NNN lease with no exit, personal guarantee, landlord demolition right, and 3-day default notice. Highest-risk lease.

source_text:
PLATFORM SERVICES AGREEMENT

December 1, 2025 between Horizon Analytics Inc. ("Provider") and Summit Healthcare Network ("Customer").

1. SERVICES. Provider shall make the Horizon data analytics platform available to Customer on a subscription basis.

2. DATA PROCESSING. Customer acknowledges that all data uploaded to the platform may be stored on servers located in the United States or the European Union. Provider shall comply with HIPAA requirements for Protected Health Information.

3. FEES. Annual fee of $180,000. Fees increase automatically by the greater of 5% or CPI each renewal year.

4. SECURITY. Provider shall maintain SOC 2 Type II certification. In the event of a security breach, Provider shall notify Customer within seventy-two (72) hours.

5. LIABILITY. Provider's aggregate liability shall not exceed one year's subscription fees. Provider shall not be liable for any loss of data, revenue, or profits.

6. TERM. Initial term of two (2) years. Automatically renews for successive one-year terms. Customer must provide one hundred twenty (120) days advance written notice to avoid renewal.

7. GOVERNING LAW. State of Massachusetts.
notes: Healthcare SaaS: 120-day opt-out notice, automatic price increase, HIPAA obligations. Medium-high risk.

source_text:
STANDARD PURCHASE ORDER AGREEMENT

October 15, 2025 between Green Valley Organics LLC ("Buyer") and Fresh Farm Co-op ("Seller").

1. PRODUCTS. Seller shall supply organic produce as described in individual purchase orders.

2. PRICE. Per unit prices as agreed in each purchase order. Prices fixed for thirty (30) days from order date.

3. DELIVERY. Seller shall deliver within three (3) business days of order. Risk of loss passes to Buyer upon delivery.

4. PAYMENT. Buyer shall pay within thirty (30) days of invoice.

5. WARRANTIES. Seller warrants all produce meets USDA organic certification standards at time of delivery.

6. GOVERNING LAW. State of California.
notes: Simple commodity purchase order. No significant risks expected.
